notes.title: Beta Update 19
notes.notes:
This week's update introduces a big change to the core game - asymmetric damage.

Broadly speaking units are now divided up into different armor classes:

[list]
[*] unarmoured
[*] light
[*] medium
[*] heavy
[*] super heavy
[/list]

Weapon effectiveness has been adjusted for each unit but generally heavier armour requires larger caliber weaponry to defeat it.

For example small arms fire is now dramatically less effective against heavier armor types than before.

RPGs are effective against heavy armor but are now less effective against agile infantry and special forces.

MG towers are now much less effective against heavy armor.

AA towers are now more effective against F16s and B2 but are now less effective against armored helicopters.

Looking forward to feedback on the new balancing - particularly if anyone thinks any particular unit needs adjustment in future builds.

notes.title: Beta Update 18
notes.notes:
In this week's update the power (energy) mechanism has been added.

You can now construct power plants to generate energy.

Certain buildings such as the refinery, war factory, helipad and anti-air tower now consume energy.

In this update player's CIWS anti-air towers will go offline in a low power situation and will be unable to attack incoming enemy air units until power is restored.

Thanks for waiting an extra week for this update which was delayed due to illness. This update is a medium sized download (180mb) and contains the first version of a new campaign map 8, Turkey.

As requested by the community in discord the map contains a destroyed urban environment that can be cleared using the regular construction dozers to create build area around your headquarters.

- Fix player unit movement when in range of enemy i.e. when retreating.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105339/57ebce017ca406847a2fcc339f6ccaf132291887.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38105339/64f2bbb6a802d166d6746acf3e9c47133802c792.jpg[/img][/url]

The secondary feature update in this release is the new main menu option screen which allows new video, audio and gameplay preferences to be set to your liking. Please note that these settings are not currently persistent when you close the game but will become so in a future update after feedback has been received on them.

As usual this update also includes fixes, the most notable being around B2 airstrikes.
